title: Mexican Prosecutor Who Helped C.I.A. Secretly Operate in His State Flees to the U.S.
summary_full: The prosecutor, who faces arrest in Mexico after allowing C.I.A. officers into Chihuahua state, is under the protection of the U.S. government, according to U.S. and Mexican officials.
